title: Engagement Naming Config
description: Schema for the root .engagement.json, which the naming checks read: the engagement prefix for engagement-authored plugins and skills, and the generic plugins that carry no prefix.

prefix.description: Short engagement code chosen at init (2 to 8 lowercase letters or digits, starting with a letter). Engagement-authored plugins and their skills are named <prefix>-<name>. Holds the init placeholder until scripts/init-engagement.sh has run.

genericPlugins.description: Plugin directories that belong to the generic layer shipped by the template. They and their skills carry no prefix.
